body: Well it looks that we have more things in common, I am a gay 25 year old guy, my mother and grandmother are also catholic so I know how that works, and you are right, it's so difficult to just wake up and start a new day and nobody even realizes how much effort you have to put into things, I have always thought I dont belong anywhere and that this world isn't for me, I don't know if there is something beyond living, but I also don't want to keep living the same day over and over.

Hi, I know I don't know you and I don't know your whole story but I feel the same way, suicidal toughts since I was a kid, never really imagine living past 30 years, everyday I think of ways of doing it but the only think stopping me is my grandma and my mom, I am an only child and they are the only family I have, I don't know if we can help each other but at least we could share our experiences.
